# Explain What You Want in Your Next Role

[← Amazon](../README.md) · [Every Amazon question](../../amazon.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/explain-what-you-want-in-your-next-role)

---

What are you looking for in your next role, and why this company?
### Constraints & Assumptions
Use a real example and distinguish your contribution from the team's work. The source provides the interview question, not a candidate answer; illustrative stories in the solution are fictional.
### Clarifying Questions
What duties and development areas are most important to you? Which confirmed parts of the position link to those aims? What unresolved matters do you have about the group?
### What a Strong Answer Covers
A precise alignment of your objectives, proven abilities, and validated job requirements, avoiding vague flattery or made-up corporate details.
### Follow-up Questions
Which compromises are you prepared to accept? In what ways would this position be unlike your present one? What must you understand prior to judging it suitable?
Overview:
Describe your drive for the upcoming position by linking individual ambitions and proof-supported capabilities to checked team requirements, also recognizing lingering queries and concessions.
